title: Mystic Library Grimoire
description: An ancient open book with glowing magical circles and dripping golden liquid rests on a gnarled tree-root stand in a candlelit library. A hooded figure reads by a cracked arched window showing a sunset sky, while bookshelves, hanging lanterns, chains, and scattered papers fill the stone chamber.
prompt: A highly detailed fantasy scene inside an ancient stone library with a massive gnarled tree growing through the bookshelves. In the center, an oversized open magical grimoire with glowing spiral runes and golden dripping liquid rests on a root stand. A hooded figure reads a book by a cracked arched window revealing a dramatic sunset. Candles, hanging lanterns, chains, and scattered papers surround the scene, warm candlelight illuminates the atmosphere.
